Name TimeBaseProviderNotification_Eth_{timeBaseName} Kind RequiredPort Interface TimeBaseProviderNotification_Eth_{timeBaseName} Description – Variation FOR timeBase : ECV . subEltList ( "StbM / StbMSynchronizedTimeBase" ); LET timeBaseName = timeBase . shortname (); timeBaseType = timeBase . subElt ( "StbMSynchronizedTimeBaseType" ). value (); validationEnabled = timeBase . subElt ( "StbMTimeValidation" ). isDefined (); ethDomains = ECV . subEltList ( "EthTSyn / EthTSynGlobalTimeDomain" ); ethDomainWithRefFilter ( domain ) = ( domain . subElt ( "EthTSynSynchronizedTimeBaseRef" ). deref () == timeBase ); ethDomainsWithRef = ethDomains . filter ( ethDomainWithRefFilter ); WHERE validationEnabled AND ( timeBaseType == "TBTYPE_SYNCHRONIZED" ) AND ( ethDomainsWithRef . count () gt 0 );
